codeReview.summary: Clean, focused implementation. learnFromResult in extensions/learn.ts correctly handles all three WorkerResult statuses (failure, success, blocked). Failure patterns are extracted with kind/message/details. Success workarounds come from handoff.discoveredIssues and notes. The spawnAndLearn toggle is respected as an early return guard. Integration into spawn-worker.ts is minimal and correct: placed after writeRunArtifacts, before validation, with protocol cache invalidation when learning occurs. Tests are thorough with 20 cases covering all VAL-LEARN and VAL-CROSS assertions plus edge cases. The TDD procedure was followed (tests written first, then implementation).

issues.description: Unused import: readFileSync is imported from node:fs but never used in any test case. Biome flags this as noUnusedImports error.

Unused import: appendLibraryTopic is imported from library.js but never used directly in any test (tests call learnFromResult which internally calls appendLibraryTopic). Biome flags this as noUnusedImports error.
Import order not sorted per biome organizeImports rule. The learn.js import should come before library.js import alphabetically.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The worker ran biome check only on extensions/ directory (as documented in AGENTS.md), but the test file test/tools/learn.test.ts has biome lint errors (unused imports: readFileSync, appendLibraryTopic; unsorted imports). The mission AGENTS.md and skill both say 'Run npx @biomejs/biome check --write extensions/' which excludes test/. If test files should also pass biome checks, the documented lint command should include test/ as well.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Running 'npx @biomejs/biome check test/tools/learn.test.ts' reports 2 errors (noUnusedImports for readFileSync and appendLibraryTopic), 2 warnings (organizeImports, formatting). The skill SKILL.md step 10 says 'Run npx @biomejs/biome check --write extensions/' — test directory excluded.

summary: The spawn-and-learn feature is well implemented. The core learnFromResult function is clean, handles all WorkerResult statuses correctly, and respects the spawnAndLearn toggle completely. Integration into spawn-worker.ts is minimal (3 lines) and correctly placed after artifact writing but before validation, with protocol cache invalidation when learning occurs. The end-to-end flow (learn → append pitfalls.md → readLibraryTopic → worker prompt injection) is verified by tracing through the codebase. All 20 tests pass and cover the required VAL-LEARN and VAL-CROSS assertions. The only issues are non-blocking: unused imports and unsorted imports in the test file, which biome flags but were not caught because the documented lint command targets only extensions/.
